These browser libraries are served locally and loaded only on the article page.

- Marked 18.2.0: https://github.com/markedjs/marked/releases/tag/v18.2.0
  - Download: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@18.2.0/lib/marked.umd.js
  - License: marked.LICENSE
- DOMPurify 3.4.18: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/releases/tag/3.4.18
  - Download: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.4.18/dist/purify.min.js
  - License: DOMPurify.LICENSE

When updating, pin the new versions, preserve the licenses, and check both
Markdown/HTML formatting and removal of scripts, event handlers, and unsafe URLs.
